content.comment_body: I successfully installed the [product_name], but I no longer see the add-ins tab in Excel, so I'm unable to log in to my [product_name] module. Could someone advise what might be causing this or how to resolve it? I am using Excel 2019. Thank you for your assistance.

I've found a way to fix it. Go to File > Options > Trust Center in Excel. Choose "Trust Center Settings...", then select "Trusted Locations" and add the location where the [product_name] plug-in is installed. This solution works for me.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience issues with missing add-ins tab in Excel after installing [product_name], which prevents access to necessary functions. Compatibility with Excel 2019 is questioned until a user discovers that modifying Trust Center settings can restore functionality. This situation points to gaps in compatibility information and user guidance during installation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to install smoothly, integrate with any version of Excel, and allow uninterrupted access to required Excel add-ins for module login.
